title: .respawnpack/runtime/delegations.json — the delegation closure archive
description: Written by kernel/lib/closeout.js completeDelegation(), bounded to the last 50. GITIGNORED. ⛔ THE ASYMMETRY WITH GOAL COMPLETION IS DELIBERATE AND IS RECORDED IN THE DATA: a goal closes MECHANICALLY and refuses on an unmet or unevaluable criterion; a delegation closes by ATTESTATION, because acceptance criteria are prose nothing can evaluate. What is mechanised instead is that every recorded criterion must be restated. The `attestation` field says so in the archive itself, so a later reader cannot mistake the record for a proof.

attestation.const: the closing caller restated every recorded acceptance criterion; this is a claim, not a proof

alsoClaimed.description: Present only when the caller attested to criteria that were never recorded — kept rather than dropped, because a closure that claims more than was asked is worth seeing.
